name: BytePlus
tagline: Navy-and-gold deck with the BytePlus wordmark, product timeline and a media-first runtime for image and video proof slides.
density: medium: one claim per slide, proof in images and videos

palette.description: all-dark deep-navy slides with a blue glow top-right (the BytePlus wordmark is white), warm off-white text, one antique-gold accent; the only other colour comes from the logo, product logos and the customer's media

typography.cn: Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC
typography.style: serif headlines with a gold-italic second half, sans body, uppercase mono chrome; sizes in calc(N * var(--u)) with --u = min(1vw, 1.7778vh)

canvas: fluid 100vw x 100vh slides kept at 16:9 proportions by --u
best_for: BytePlus solution and product decks that prove claims with real outputs: image before/after pairs, an interactive layer playground, vertical ad videos, demo recordings, plus the standard About-BytePlus timeline.
avoid_for: Light-background or printed handouts (use byteplus-light), long-form reading, Bible/teaching decks.
layouts: layer playground (drag / resize / rotate cut-out layers, move them between two images)
agent explainer (flow bar + points + full-screen demo)
navigation: slide engine (arrows, space, Home/End, wheel, swipe, nav dots) + media runtime (video model, lightbox, tabs, layer playground, N notes, F fullscreen)
source: BytePlus pitch deck; generate new decks with scripts/build_deck.py
